voice.name: en-US-AndrewNeural
voice.prosody: The best time is sunrise; climb a hill while the balloons are up. Entry to the Open Air Museum is paid, and the Turkish museum pass is valid. The Dark Church may cost extra. Inside the rock churches, please do not take photos or touch the frescoes. Local tip: even without a balloon ride, watch the sunrise from a hill. Nobody charges for that view. Your next stop is the Zelve open-air site, about three kilometres by car, around ten minutes.
